# Run 1 (world: The Free Cities)
Session open. Chapter 2. Approval: autopilot. Spoilers: off.

## Changed since last session
Nothing changed since the last session.

## Settings
- as of: Spring, year 300
- genre: low fantasy
- tone: grim
- difficulty: balanced
- length: standard
- pacing: balanced
- dice: GM rolls
- turn_length: standard
- lines: harm to children
- veils: sexual content

## Voice anchor
Interior level: deep
Clipped, close third person, past tense. Plain diction, hard edges, dry humor; violence quick and ugly.

Sample:
> Rain came off the Black Wall in sheets, and the squire counted coins he didn't have.

input.summary: The next afternoon (three days before the new moon) Marro went to deliver Lissa's letter, but the Long Bridge is gated at its western end and he has no pass. An old ferryman on the mud below offered to smuggle him across for three stags. Marro turned back without crossing; the letter is still undelivered.

updates.body: The Golden Company's camp lies on the western bank of the Rhoyne; the Dragon's Den is on the eastern bank, so reaching it from camp means crossing the Long Bridge or the river.

The Triarch's men hold a fresh timber gate at the western end of the Long Bridge: six spearmen in tiger-striped cloaks and a clerk with a ledger and a brass seal who stamps passes. Most people are turned back.
The ferries on the western bank have been told not to work, but an old bald, toothless ferryman offered to smuggle Marro across the Rhoyne for three silver stags.
Lissa's letter is still undelivered; Marro turned back at the Long Bridge without crossing.

thread_changes.body: Blocked by the closed bridge; a smuggling ferryman will cross for three stags.
